instructions: Domain-adapted evidence loop: separate false alarms, missed faults and coverage; allow bounded interaction/recall feature exploration, single-factor device weights and optional independent parallel branch. Reuse the source sampling policy and fixed evaluation. New source/representation requires a new cache/session. TEST stays outside search. TypeB only. Use supplied baseline features; do not infer healthy labels beyond May 2024.
